messages.text: I need to find a hotel in Cambridge that's moderately priced. I don't need to have free parking included for my stay.
There are four possibilities, one is a hotel and the others are guesthouses. Do you have a preference for one or the other?
I do not. Are any of those places located in the centre?
Only one is located in the centre. The cityroomz which also has free wifi. Would you be interested in booking this hotel?
Yes, that sounds splendid. I would like to book a room there for 6 people for 2 nights, and I would like the reference number, please.
What night would you like to begin your stay?
I would like to stay starting Tuesday night
I have booked the cityroomz hotel for 2 nights, starting this Tuesday, for 6 people.
That is great! How much?
I apologize I don't have the price. It is in the moderate price range however.
I see. That sounds great. Thank you. Could I get a reference number please?
Your reference number is : EB05KFXV. Will there be anything else today?
I also need a restaurant that serves turkish food please.
There are three Turkish restaurants, all in the center of town. The Meze Bar is expensive, but the other two are more moderate. Would you like to book a table?
the meze bar is fine. book it for 6 at 14:15 on tuesday
Your table will be reserved for 15 minutes. The reference number is XZX9AGML.
Thank you so much!
You are welcome. Have a nice day!
I need a restaurant in the west that serves Hungarian cuisine,
I'm sorry. There is no matching restaurant. Do you want to try a different area or food type?
I guess let's check and see if there are any Hungarian restaurants in other parts of town. What is in the south?
I'm sorry there are no hungarian restaurants coming up anywhere.  Is there another type of cuisine you'd like me to look for?
Are there any restaurants in the west and in the expensive price range that serves indian food?
There are 5 of them. I hear the Cocum is very good. Would you be interested in booking it?
Is this location in the west? If so yes, i would like to book a table.
Great, what day, time, and number of people would you like to book for at Cocum?
Please book a table for 7 people at 11:45 on monday.
I'm sorry that time slot is not available that day. Would you care to try for a different time or day perhaps?
Let's try 10:45.
I was able to get you a table for 7 at Cocum on Monday at 10:45. Reference number is : AZ2DU7IR. Can I be of any further assistance today?
Yes, I am also looking for a three star hotel located in the same area as the restaurant.
Hobsons House is a moderately-priced, 3-star guesthouse in the west. It offers free internet and parking. Would you like me to book this for you?
Great, can I please have the address and phone number?
Certainly. Hobsons House is located at 96 Barton Road. It's phone number is 01223304906. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Actually, yes. I need a taxi to transport between the two places. I want to make sure it arrives at Cocum at the booked time. Any ideas?
I have your taxi scheduled to arrive in time for your parties reservation. Is there antying else I can take care of for you?
Can I get the contact number and car type please.
Certainly Booked car type blue bmw, and Contact number 07581556997. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
I think that should be it thank you
Thank you for booking with us and have a great day.
I'm looking for a restaurant, in the moderate price range, in the southern part of town.
Pizza Hut Cherry Hinton and Restaurant Alimentum both meet your criteria. Would you like a table at one of these?
How about Restaurant Alimentum for 8 people on Wednesday at 16:30? That would be good.
Your booking was successful. Reference number 6NOL39Q9. Can I help you with anything else?
Yes I also need a place to stay. I would prefer a guesthouse. That's the only thing that really matters.
There are 24 guesthouses. Would you like to narrow this down by price range, area, star rating, or amenities?
I specifically want free parking and don't mind if there is no Internet.
That narrows it down to 21 places. Is there a price range, area, or star rating you're looking for?
How about a place with free parking and free wifi?
Certainly,  acorn guest house, alexander bed and breakfast, allenbell, and archway house are all four star rated.
Great I need 8 people for 3 nights starting wednesday.
OK, I've booked you at the allenbell guesthouse 517a coldham lane for three nights starting wednesday for 8 guests. Your reference number is 1E099Y11. Is there anything else?
Is this acceptable? Is there anything else I can help you with?
Will you be needing further assistance today?
No. Thank you that is all I needed.
Your welcome! Have a good day! Goodbye.
I would like to book a five star, or closest to it, in the east part of town please.
There are several hotels with those characteristics. Could you narrow down by price range and hotel type you want?
I am looking to stay in a guesthouse in the expensive price range.
There are no hotels which match your criteria. Can I help you find something else?
What about a hotel in a cheap price range?
Your options are: Allenbell, Autumn house, and Leverton house. All of these guesthouses have 4 stars, are in the east part of town, and offer free parking and WiFi.
I would like to book the Autumn house starting Monday for 4 nights for 2 people.
Great your reference number is DPEISTWK.
What expensive restaurants are in the East part of town?
There is Yu Garden and Royal Standard.
What cheap restaurants are in the East part of town?
The Missing Sock is a cheap restaurant in the east part of town. They serve international food. Would you like me to book that for you?
Yes please for 2 people on monday, thanks.
Absolutely. What time would you like?
I need that for 13:00 and I would appreciate a reference number.
I booked that reservation for you. Your reference number is VN4QZ2M1. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No thank you
You're welcome. Have a nice day.
Are the any guest house type places to stay in the north part of town available?
There are several available. Would you like us to book one for you?
as long as it has free wifi and is moderately priced in the area of north.
There are 8 guesthouses on the north side of town that offer free internet and are moderately priced. What dates would you like to book and for how many people?
book for 2 people for days starting may 5 to may 7.
We have acorn guest house, arbury lodge guesthouse, archway house, avalon, hamilton lodge, home from home, kirkwood house, or limehouse?
Can you book the limehouse for 1 person to stay 4 nights starting saturday?
Booking was unsuccessful. Would you like to book for another day or a shorter stay?
how about 3 nights? Also could I get the reference number for the limehouse, and do you know if there is Indian food nearby it?
I have successfully booked your room at the Limehouse. Your reference number is 4VB8JH2B. As for the restaurant, do you have any preferences as far as price range goes?
No preferences for the price range, but I'd like it to be in the same area as the hotel.
There is the Nirala, it is moderately priced and the Royal Spice which is in the cheap price range.  Would you like me to book a table for you at one of these locations?
No thanks. I just need the phone number and postcode for each.
The number for The Nirala is 01223360966 cb41uy. The number for Royal Spice is 01733553355 and the postcode is cb41eh.
Thank you. That's all I need today.
Thank you and have a good day.
I am looking for a local,cheap place to eat.
There are a total of 22 restaurants that are cheap. Any particular food type you would like?
Yes, I am looking for portuguese food.
I found two restaurants in the area that serve Portuguese food. Would you like me to book one now?
No thank you, could you provide me with the phone number and postcode?
The phone number is 01223327908 and postcode is cb23ar
Thank you I need a place to stay also. I was hoping to stay in the east.
There are 5 hotels in the east. Do you prefer the moderate or cheap price range?
I don't really know what price range. I would like it to have a 3 star rating and free wifi though.
I was not able to find any hotels matching that requirement.
Ok, could you check in the south area for one instead?
I found two: Bridge Guest House in a moderate price range or The Lensfield Hotel in an expensive price range. Would you like to book one?
Okay, what is the postcode of the Bridge Guest House?
The postcode for the Bridge Guest House is cb28rj.
I will need a taxi from the hotel to the restaurant. I want to leave the hotel by 7:15.
I have booked you taxi fro your hotel to nandos city centre, leaving at 07:15. The contact number is 07137465500. Can I help with anything else?
What type of car is the taxi?
The taxi is a blue tesla. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's all I need today. I appreciate all your help - thanks!
I'm glad we could be of service, have a nice day!
Can you help me fine a local restaurant? I am looking for a moderately priced place to dine that is located somewhere near the centre.
There are a total of 21 restaurants that match that criteria. Is there a certain style of food you are wanting?
No particular food style, but I need a reservation for 1 on Saturday at 11:30, once I decide on a place I will need a reference number.
Do you have a further preference to reduce the number of acceptable entries?
I am also looking for a place to stay. I need a guesthouse with free wifi.
Booking was successful at yippee noodle bar. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. Reference number is : K1103XE1.
Thank you!  Is there a guesthouse with free parking and wifi nearby?
We have the Alexander Bed and Breakfast a 4 star guesthouse in the centre part of town in the cheap price range. Does this sound acceptable to book?
Are there any hotels instead of guesthouses with the same criteria?
The University Arms Hotel might be your best bet. It is an expensive 4-star hotel in the center of town with free wifi and free parking.
Actually, can you please book the Alexander Bed and Breakfast instead? I'll be arriving on Saturday and need a room for 4 nights. Just one person.
I'm sorry, but there are no vacancies for your requested time. Would you like to try a different day or perhaps a shorter stay?
Is it available for a single night stay?
Yes. I have booked your reservation for one night. The reference number is Q1BD4PP0
I also need a taxi in order to commute
when do you want to depart and/or arrive?
I'll want to leave the guesthouse to arrive at our lunch reservation by 11:30. Please let me know the car type of the taxi and a contact number.
I have booked you a taxi meeting your requirements. It is a yellow volkswagen and the contact number is 07340142322.
Great. Thank you. That is all I need for today.
Good day then, pleasure serving you.
I'm looking for a cheap restaurant that serves modern european food.
the river bar steakhouse and grill meets your preferences. They are located in centre at Quayside Off Bridge Street.
Thank you very much.
You're welcome, goodbye.
Wait, I need a reservation, please. Can I get a table on Wednesday at 18:45 for 2 people? I'll need the reference number.
Your reservation is all set, reference number is U4UFT1IY
I need a cheap place to stay, too. Can you find me something in the centre?
The Alexander Bed and Breakfast guesthouse is 4 stars and the El Shaddai is 0 stars.  Would you like me to book one of these options for you?
The Alexander Bed and Breakfast guesthouse will be fine, thanks.
Thank you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
I need more information about the guesthouse, do they have free parking?  What is the address and phone number?
Parking is free, the phone number is 01223525725 and the address is 56 saint barnabas road.
Could you book a taxi for me? I am looking for one to take me between the restaurant and hotel and i need it to arrive at the restaurant by the booked time.
I have booked the taxi, the contact number is 07846881745. The car type is a grey ford. Anything else I can help you with today?
No that's all I needed. Thank you!
You're Welcome. Thank you for using our services.
Hi, I need a hotel that includes free wifi in the north of Cambridge.
Yes I have many listings for that type of hotel,if you tell me your price range I can narrow down your options.
Hotel doesn't need to have free parking. I don't care about price range.
The avalon is a moderately priced guesthouse-type that matches your criteria.
What is the postcode, price range, and address?
The postcode for the Avalon is cb43pd, it is moderately priced hotel, and it is located at 62 gilbert road.
Thank you so much. I am also looking for information on a place to dine in the same area of the hotel. I would prefer international food.
Unfortunately there are no matching restaurants in the North. Would you like to try a different type of cuisine, or a different area?
Maybe... are you sure there is no cheap international food in the north?
No I am sorry there are no locations I have found. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Since there is no cheap international restaurants, is there any Italian restaurants?
There is one, Da Vinci Pizzeria, would you like to book that?
Hold off on booking. Could you give me the address and phone number for it?
Sure, da vinci pizzeria is located at 20 Milton Road Chesterton postcode cb41jy, phone 01223351707.  Can I help you with anything else?
No that should be all thank you
Thank you, goodbye.
Hi, I am looking for a Chinese restaurant in the centre.
There are 10 Chinese restaurants in the centre. Is there a particular price range you're interested in?
Yes, I would prefer a restaurant in the moderate price range.
Might I suggest the Jinling Noodle Bar? I can book a table there for you, if you like.
No, thank you. I would like the address, phone number and postcode, please.
Sure. The address is 11 Peas Hill City Centre, the postcode is cb23pp, and the phone number is 01223566188. What else can I do for you?
Yes I'm also looking for a place to stay.
Sure, I have 33 hotel options available. Can you tell me more about what you need? What area or price range, perhaps?
Is there anything within walking distance of the Jinling?
I have a cheaper guesthouse nearby the restaurant named El Shaddai or an expensive hotel called CityRoomz. Would you like more information on one of those?
I am looking for a hotel with free wifi available for 3 people for 3 nights starting sunday
Ok, Cityroomz has free wifi. Unfortunately, they cannot book for 3 nights. Would you like to try El Shaddai or another night?
Actually, I'd like a moderate hotel in the centre with free wifi. I need to book it for 3 people for 3 nights starting Sunday. And a reference number please?
Great! You're all set. Your reference number is G7YT1WEQ. How else may I assist you?
Yes. I'd like to book a taxi between both places. I want to leave the hotel by 20:00. Please provide me with a contact number and car type.
Great, you have a black Toyota booked from Cityroomz to Jinling Noodle Bar, the contact number is 07486349106
Thank you so much, that's all I need
You're welcome! It was a pleasure assisting you!
I need a Korean restaurant in the centre of town.
How about little seoul? It's expensive and in the center of town.
Is there other choices that you could provide?
I'm sorry, there are no other options for the criteria you have provided. Would you like more information about little seoul?
i want to make a booking for 8 people at 13:30 on Monday. please do send me a reference number.
Okay I would be more than happy to assist you with that but I need to know how many will be in your party and what time please.
Please book for 8 people on Monday at 13:30.
Booking was successful. The table will be reserved for 15 minutes. Reference number is : 20X96EGN. Is there anything else you would like for me to do?
I'm also looking for hotel in the same area.
There are more than thirty options to choose from. Do you have a preferred star rating or price range?
I want one in centre, also expensive and free parking please.
There are two hotels that meet that criteria. The gonville hotel and the university arms hotel. Do you have a star rating preference?
I also need free wifi. Stars don't matter, but can you get me their phone number?
The Gonville's phone is 01223366611 and the University Arms Hotel's number is 01223351241. Can I help with anything else today?
No, that's it. Thank you. Goodbye!
Alright then. Have a good stay!
Hello, I am looking for a moderate priced place to eat that serves British food in Cambridge.
Would you be interested in a couple of recommendations? I have The Copper Kettle in the centre and Saint Johns Chop House in the west. Both serve great British cuisine.
Can I have The Copper Kettle's phone number and address, please?
Of course! The Copper Kettle's number is 01223323361 and they are located at 4 Kings Parade City Centre.
What is the area for The copper Kettle?
The Copper Kettle is located in the center of town.
I would like to book a cab please.
Alright. I will need more information first. Where can the taxi pick you up, when would you like to leave, and when do you need to arrive?
I don't care.
I am sorry, I cannot book a taxi for you without this information.
I need a place to stay please.
I have 33 results for a place to stay. Would you prefer a hotel or a guesthouse? Did you have a preference on location?
Someplace moderately priced with free wifi on the east side of town would be best.
There are 3 results for a place to stay, would you like me to book you a room now?
Sure. I need to book it for 3 people staying for 4 nights starting sunday. Please provide a reference number. Thanks!
A and B Guest House meets your criteria so I have booked it for you.  The reference number is N5NTPZKL.
Thanks. That's everything I need.
All right, if you're sure you don't need a taxi as well, have a very good day, then.
I will.  Thanks for your help.
If you need to book a taxi , please call back. Thank you.
Find me a Mediterranean restaurant in the centre of Cambridge.
The gardenia fits your criteria, can I book that for you?
Yes, please book that for me.
How many people and what time/day are you looking at?
I need the table booked for monday at 12:15 for 3 people. Thanks. Also could i get the ref #?
Booking was successful. Your reference number is: NZ89K99X, they will only hold your table for 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great I also am looking for a hotel to stay at that includes free parking. What's available?
I have found  acorn guest house		which is a 4 star guesthouse and includes free parking.
Actually, I'm looking for a hotel and in the same price range as the restaurant.
Can you please restate your hotel needs clearly? Thank you!
Yes I need a hotel in the same price range as the restaurant with free parking.
There are five hotels in the expensive price range. Do you have any other preferences?
Can you give me the first one and the star rating for it please? It has to have free parking.
express by holiday inn cambridge is rated 2 stars. Do you want me to make a booking there?
Does the Express by Holiday Inn have free parking?
Yes, the Express by Holiday Inn does have free parking. Do you want me to go ahead and make a booking for you?
Yes also I will need a taxi to get me between the hotel and the restaurant. I will need a contact number and car type with the booking.
First I need to know how many are in your party, what day you wish to check in, and how many nights you need a room.
I'd just like to book a taxi between the two. I'd like to get to the restaurant by my reservation time and I'll need the contact number and car type please.
Your reservation is for 12:15 with reference number NZ89K99X .  And I have reserved a Grey Tesla to get you there.  Contact number is 07635386509.
What time will the taxi arrive?
It will take about twenty minutes to get to the restaurant from the hotel. Say the taxi gets there at 11:30?
That will be fine.
Is there anything else that I can help you with today?
No, that's it.  Thanks!
You're welcome. Have a pleasant stay, goodbye.
I am looking for some places to go, do you have any attractions in the east?
I have several places that may interest you on that side of town. What type of place are you looking for?
I really don't have a preference.  Can you recommend a few?
Well, we have camboats and the cambridge museum of technology, both of which are interesting places.  Would you like information about either of these?
Sure. also could you help me find a restaurant serving unusual food in the same part of town?
There doesn't seem to be any restaurants in that area that serve unusual food.  Do you have another food preference?
How about Italian?
Yes I have the Pizza Hut fen Ditton on the east side serving Italian food and it is moderately priced.
Can I get the postcode and phone number please?
Their postcode is cb58wr and phone number is 01223323737
Thank you so much. I think that's all I need.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else at all that I could assist you with?
I forgot to ask; what is the postcode for the Cambridge Museum of Technology that you mentioned earlier?
The postcode is cb58ld.  Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that should do it, thanks!
You're welcome! Have a nice day!
Can you help me find a place to eat? I am looking for a place that serves cheap corsica food.
I'm sorry, we have no cheap corsica eateries. Care to try anything else?
Tell me some restaurant types in the town centre?
There's Chinese, Indian, Italian, Mediterranean, and Spanish, there's a few others if none of those sound appealing.
Could you please find me an italian restaurant in the centre?
Of course! I have three: Pizza Hut City Centre, Ask, and Zizzi Cambridge. Would you like to book one of these?
Yes, can you book a table for 1 at Zizzi Cambridge? I would like to go at 11:15 on tuesday.
yes certainly. I have you booked on Tuesday at 11:15 and your reference number for the booking is LMJ96HRL.
I would also like to find an attraction to go to after the meal in the same part of town.
I have a few meseums,  Theatre, Collages..What do you have inmind?
A museum sounds good can I get the phone number and entrance fee of one?
Broughton House Gallery is free. Their phone number is 01223314960.
Great, thank you! That's all I'll need for today.
OK great! I hope you have a wonderful day!
I'm looking for a restaurant in the city centre.
There are 69 results for restaurants in city centre. Could you be more specific on what type of food you're hungry for, or price range you'd like?
I would like a restaurant that serves British food.
There are 7 British restaurants in the centre. Do you have a preferred price range?
No I do not, can you please find me the highest rated restaurant?
I do not have access to restaurant ratings, however three of the restaurants serving British food are considered expensive. Would you like their information?
Just one please, and only the address is necessary. I'd also like a place to go in town, a museum is good, it should be in the centre
The address for Fitzbillies is 51 Trumpington Street City Centre.
Okay, thanks. And a museum?
there are approximately 11 museums in the centre of town, all with free entrance. My personal recommendation would be the Whipple Museum of the History of Science.
Sounds good. What's the address and phone number of the Whipple?
It is located at free school lane and their phone number is 01223330906
Alright, great. I also need a taxi to get between the restaurant and the museum. I want to leave the restaurant by 23:45.
I was able to arrange your taxi service. Your vehicle will be a Black BMW, and the company's contact number is 07015861608. Anything else I can help with?
No that will be all, thank you.
We are happy to help. Thank you for using our service.
I am looking for places to go, do you have any attractions in the west part of town?
I have several museums and a few colleges to choose from. Which would you prefer?
I think I would prefer a museum.
The Museum of Classical Archaeology would be a fun place to check out, would you be interested?
Sure, give me their phone number. I'd also like to find an expensive restaurant in West Cambridge.
Here's the number for the Museum of Classical Archaeology, 01223335153. How does the Cambridge Lodge Restaurant sound for you?
That sounds good.  Could you reserve a table for 3 on Friday at 19:00?  Can I get a reference number?  Thank you!
It's all booked reference number is 8L9SAXV0
I also want to book a taxi to go from the museum to the restaurant.
When would you like to arrive by?
I would like for the taxi arrive by 19:00 please. Can you give me a contact number and the car type for the taxi as well?
Yes, the taxi will be a red BMW and the contact number is 07530062984
Thank you, that's all I need today.
You're welcome! Goodbye!
Hi I am looking for a college to go to in town.
There are 18 different colleges, did you have an area in mind?
Yes, the centre area.
Christ's college is in town centre located at saint andrew's street and has free entrance. Would you like their phone number as well?
Yes, and can you find me an Italian restaurant in the same area?
The address for Christ's College is Saint Andrew's Street and the phone number is 01223334900. There are 9 Italian restaurants in the center.  Is there are price range you need?
Yes, I'm looking for something expensive.
There are four in the area. Statizione Restaurant and Coffee Bar, Clowns Cafe, Don Pasquale Pizzeria, and Caffe Uno. Can I make reservations for any of these?
I think I'll try the Caffe Uno. Can I get a table for 5 at 12:15 on Sunday?
I have reserved your table at cafe uno for 5 on Sunday at 12:15.  Is there anything else I can help you with?
Yes could I have my booking reference number please?
Sure. Your reference number is D5JM6NE7.
Thank you very much. That is all I needed. Have a good day.
You're welcome. Goodbye.
I am looking for a restaurant in the west part of town.
What type of food are you looking for and what price range?
I am looking for a restaurant in the moderate price range and the food type for those restaurants.
British, Indian, or Italian.
Indian. And can you find me something to do afterwards in the same area of town?
Meghna is a restaurant in the west serving indian food in the moderate price range. Do you need more information or want to reserve a table?
I'd just like the address for now, thanks.  Are there any attractions in the west part of town?
The address is 205 Victoria Road Chesterton. Anything else I can do for you?
Could be please call a cab?
I'd be happy to help you with a taxi, what is your destination/departure and what time would you like to arrive/leave?
Nevermind, I actually don't need one.
There are 13 attractions in the west area of town. Would you like more information?
What is the entrance fee for the attractions?
Churchill college is free in the west part of town.
Thanks, that's all I need. Have a nice day.
I'm happy to help. You have a great day as well.
Can you help me find a place to eat? I am looking for somewhere in the east with a moderate price.
There is the Curry Prince and Rajmahal restuarants serving Indian food.  Then there is the Pizza Hut Fen Ditton serving Italian food. Which would you like more information on?
I think I'd like to try Rajmahal. Could you book me a table for 1 on Monday at 16:15?
Your reservation has been booked. Your reference number is Q9DRQ55J. Please be aware that your table will only be reserved until 16:30. Can i provide any more assistance?
I'm also looking for things to do in the same general area as the restaurant.
Sure, are you interested in museums, sports, parks, entertainment, swimming or boating?
Are there any cinemas? If there isn't what about something that has to do with multiple sports?
There aren't any cinemas in the general area, but what types of sports are you interested in?
All of them. What's there?
The Cherry Hinton Village Centre is the only one located there, their address is Colville Road, Cherry Hinton. Anything else I can help you with?
Can I please get the phone number?
Yes, the phone number is 01223576412. How else can I help?
That will be all, thank you very much for all of your help.
Thank you let me know if you need help again.
I'm looking for a restaurant in the centre of town
There are over 60 restaurants near the center of town, do you have a cuisine or price range in mind?
Yes, something in the affordable price range. Also, do any of them serve singaporean food?
There are no Singaporean restaurants, but there are cheap ones offering several different cuisines.
Okay what about Italian food then?
Zizzi Cambridge serves italian cuisine in the city centre.  Would you like a reservation?
Not right now, but can I have their postcode, please?
Their postcode is cb21ab
Thank you. I am also looking for some places to go. Can you help with that?
I have a lot of different locales and attractions in my database, is there anything you'd like to see in particular? Or search by location?
What is there to see in the centre and what is the postcode?
There are 44 attractions in the center of town. Would you like a museum, or a cinema perhaps?
I prefer the cinema, is there one in the same postcode as the restaurant?
I only have one venue offering cinema in the centre but it has a different postcode than the restaurant. Vue Cinema's postcode is cb11ps. Should I look elsewhere for cinemas?
No, that one is perfect. Could you help me book a taxi please? I am looking for one to take me from Zizzi Cambridge to Vue Cinema. I'd like to leave by 22:15.
Of course. I've booked you a grey honda leaving from Zizzi Cambridge to Vue Cinema at 22:15. The contact number is 07135477113.
Thanks, that's all I need today. Have a good one.
You're welcome. Have a nice day.
What Chinese restaurants are there in the center of town?
There are 10 Chinese restaurants in the centre of town. Would you like a moderately priced one or an expensive one? We have a few cheap.
I'd like an expensive one please.
I have found tang Chinese which is here in the centre.  Would you like to start a reservation?
Yes, please book a table for 4 people at 16:15 on Friday and send me the reference number once it is booked.
I've made your reservation at Tang Chinese for 4 at 16:15, reference #D6G7VSV0. Will that be all?
Actually I'd also like suggestions on areas to visit at the center of town
There's a church called all saints church you could visit, it's listed under architecture.
Can I get the address and entrance fee.
The address is Jesus Lane, and there is no entrance fee. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Yes. Can you help me book a taxi so I can get to the restaurant on time.
Yes, I reserved a Red Tesla for you.  The contact number is 07612290033.  Is there anything else I can help with?
Will the Red Tesla get me to the restaurant for my 16:15 reservation?
Yes, your taxi will pick you up at all saints church and arrive at tang chinese by 16:15. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
